Project Description

The Department of Mathematics and Mathematical Statistics at Umeå University is offering a postdoctoral scholarship within the project "Bounds for Pancake Sorting and Analysis of the Pancake Graph". The scholarship is tax-free and amounts to 375,000 SEK for one year with starting date 1 April 2027 or by agreement. After the scholarship period, there is a possibility to apply for an extension.

The purpose is to pursue research in pancake sorting, a well-known problem in combinatorial optimization going back to a 1979 paper by Bill Gates and Papadimitriou. The project will study lower and upper bounds for both the unburnt and burnt versions and analyze the corresponding pancake graph. Specific research questions will be determined based on candidate's interests and expertise. The scholarship is funded and administered by the Kempe Foundation (JCSMK-0158).

Research Environment

The project will be carried out in close collaboration with Associate Professor Gerold Jäger. The postdoctoral scholar will interact with the Discrete Mathematics group (20 researchers), which holds weekly seminars, hosts yearly workshops, and receives frequent international visitors. Research areas include extremal and probabilistic combinatorics, combinatorial optimization, graph theory, game theory, algorithmics, and geometry.

Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree in mathematics, computer science, or a related area (or equivalent foreign degree) completed no later than the decision date.
  • Priority to candidates who completed doctoral degree within three years prior; special reasons (illness, parental leave, etc.) may extend.
  • Expertise in combinatorial optimization and graph theory.
  • Good programming skills.
  • Ability to perform research independently and as part of a team.
  • Good oral and written English.

Application

Submit via Varbi by 9 October 2026. Documents in English or Swedish, PDF (preferred) or Word:

  • Cover letter (max 2 pages) summarizing qualifications, scientific interests, motivation.
  • Research plan including motivation and ideas (max 3 pages plus references).
  • CV including complete publication list.
  • Certified copy of doctoral degree certificate or documentation of expected completion.
  • Verified copies of other diplomas, list of completed courses and grades.
  • Copy of doctoral thesis and at most three most relevant publications.
  • Contact information of two references.

Contact

Gerold Jäger, gerold.jager@umu.se, +46-90-7866141
